headline: Samsung Electro-Mechanics Q3 profit jumps 166% on strong AI demand
summary: Samsung Electro-Mechanics reported a 166% surge in third-quarter profit driven by robust demand for artificial intelligence components, prompting a share price rally.
why: Component manufacturers benefit directly from the broader hardware build-out supporting artificial intelligence infrastructure globally.

impacts.name: Samsung Electro-Mechanics
impacts.why: A 166% profit surge significantly strengthens corporate earnings reports and drives share appreciation.

why_moved: Earnings reports exceeding expectations by wide margins directly attract institutional buying and upward price revisions.
